C1247.title: Chinese-American Men Arrested in California for Tampering with Gift Cards to Steal Funds
C1247.summary: In August 2025, Santa Rosa Police arrested Yongsheng Zhao and Zhipeng Li in connection with a statewide gift card draining scheme. Police said the suspects removed gift cards from retail displays, recorded or altered activation information, resealed the cards, and returned them to shelves so that funds could be drained after purchase. Investigators seized about 25,000 suspected compromised gift cards, ledgers, and cash from a vehicle and hotel room, and booked the suspects on burglary, grand theft, access-card information theft and forgery, forgery, and conspiracy charges.
